title: Capability boundary from a track record
decision: whether a given public chat model will answer a given question correctly (asked before the model is called)

source.name: stored sampled answers of four public chat models on evaluation-only question sets (own runs)
source.split: evaluation questions of NQ, PopQA, WebQuestions, TriviaQA; BBH tasks, StrategyQA, FOLIO, ProofWriter, DROP; SVAMP, ASDiv, GSM-Hard, GSM-Plus, MAWPS

licence: labels: own; question texts keep the licences of their sources [[to be listed per source]]
notes: soft.yes = k / n correct among n sampled answers (meta.n, meta.k); the state also holds eight other questions of the same domain with that model's results Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 215 of 990 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 775 items remain.
